q: After three judges took oath on 6 October 2026, the working strength of the Supreme Court became…
x: The sanctioned strength is 38, counting the Chief Justice.

q: A new bench of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh opened in October 2026 at…
x: Inaugurated by CJI Surya Kant on 18 October. The Cabinet had approved it in August.

q: Who was approved as Deputy Election Commissioner in October 2026?
x: A 2010-batch IAS officer of the Rajasthan cadre.

q: Who was named Governor of Odisha in the President's announcement of 12 October 2026?
x: He follows Hari Babu Kambhampati. From one report only: confirm before the exam.

q: Who became the first woman Director General of the Geological Survey of India in 2026?
x: The GSI was founded in 1851 and is based in Kolkata.

q: Which state's Uniform Civil Code Bill received the President's assent in October 2026?
x: Uttarakhand was the first state to bring in such a code (2025).

q: In August 2026, which two were added to the list of notified disasters?
x: The list grew from 12 to 14.

q: Rules notified in August 2026 make which time the only legal time reference in India?
x: The Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026.

q: On 15 August 2026, Narendra Modi gave his ___ Independence Day speech in a row from the Red Fort.
x: It was the 80th Independence Day. Nehru gave 17 in a row.

q: In 2026 the Supreme Court said the 24 hours for producing an arrested person before a magistrate (Article 22(2)) count from…
o: The time written in the arrest memo
x: From the 2–8 November 2026 news.

q: In November 2026 the Supreme Court held that the OBC creamy layer cannot be decided…
x: 6 November 2026.

q: The SUMAN Roadmap 2030 aims to bring the maternal mortality ratio below…
x: SUMAN = Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan.

q: The Telecom Authorisation Rules, 2026 replace the system under which old law?
x: They are made under the Telecommunications Act, 2023.

q: PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana, approved in October 2026, aims to strengthen…
x: A centrally sponsored scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31.

q: PM Surya Sarovar Yojana, approved in July 2026, is for…
x: 5,000 MW of floating solar with storage; outlay ₹5,070 crore.

q: "Samudra Manthan", approved in 2026, is a national scheme for…
x: National Offshore Exploration Scheme, about ₹84,000 crore in Phase I.

q: Fast Track Special Courts, extended in 2026 up to March 2031, are paid for from the…
o: Consolidated Fund of the states only
x: 850 courts for rape and POCSO cases.

q: The Yugayugin Bharat Museum, approved in November 2026, comes under the Ministry of…
x: Cost about ₹3,230 crore.

q: VB–G RAM G, the law that replaced MGNREGA, came into force on…
x: It was passed in December 2025 and promises 125 days of work.

q:
1. VB–G RAM G was passed in December 2025.
2. It promises 125 days of work a year to a rural household.
Which statement is correct?
x: It replaced MGNREGA (100 days).

q:
1. A bench of the High Court for Ladakh opened at Leh in 2026.
2. Prakash Rajpurohit became Chief Election Commissioner in 2026.
Which statement is correct?
x: He became Deputy Election Commissioner. The CEC is Gyanesh Kumar.
